artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Woman
artworks.artist: Albert Sands Southworth and Josiah Johnson Hawes
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up, positioned slightly angled to the right with her head turned to the left. Her facial features are delicate with a composed expression, arched eyebrows, and dark eyes. Her hair is styled in large rolls on either side, possibly with extensions, framing her face elegantly. She is dressed in a richly textured garment with an intricately designed lace shawl draped over her shoulders. Her clothing has detailed embroidery. She holds a delicate handheld fan with both hands in front of her. She wears circular earrings and a brooch at the neck of her dress. The background is plain and dark, contrasting with her clothing. The photograph is set within a vintage frame with an ornate gold border.

artworks.title: Winter Trees, Reflected in a Pond
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph features tall, bare trees lining a body of water. In the lower half of the photograph, the reflection of the trees and the pale sky can be seen in the water.

artworks.title: Bagnères-de-Luchon at the Foot of the Castel-Vielh Tower
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountains in the distance. An isolated tower stands on a rocky hill in the foreground. The scene has a monochrome color scheme with subtle variations of grays and browns. The terrain slopes down towards a valley surrounded by mountains. Trees are scattered along the slope, adding to the tranquil setting.

artworks.title: The Yosemite Falls, from Glacier Point
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a high vantage point. A rocky ledge juts into the frame from the left, made of large boulders. In the background, there are cascading cliffs and a waterfall in a deep valley. The waterfall is slightly to the right of center, cascading down a rugged cliff. Forested mountains and ridges can be seen in the distance. The sky has soft, pale tones. The color palette is sepia-toned, enhancing textures and details. The overall effect conveys grandeur and the natural beauty of the mountains.

artworks.title: Rocken End in a Storm, Isle of Wight
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a rocky landscape with an upwards perspective. The slope is filled with large boulders. The horizon is obscured by mist or fog, creating depth. There are no visible brushstrokes, suggesting it may be a photograph with a grainy, sepia-tone texture. The color palette is earthy and muted, dominated by browns and beiges. Rocks in the foreground are detailed, while smaller rocks and landforms fade into the mist in the background.

artworks.title: The Shower-Bath
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Max N. Berry
artworks.description: This is a grayscale print of a bathhouse interior. The scene shows a detailed depiction of individuals engaged in various bathing and grooming activities. The room is bustling with activity; some individuals are swimming or emerging from a pool with a diving board on the left, while others are standing or sitting at the edge of the pool, or conversing or drying off with towels on the right. In the background there are showers and dressing areas. The occupants all appear to be men, although some are only partially visible. They are all partially or entirely nude, and they all have light skin with various hairstyles and forms of facial hair. The ground is black, while the walls of the room are light gray.

artworks.title: View into a Courtyard with a Family at a Well
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an arched stone doorway into a courtyard. The walls of the courtyard and buildings create a boundary for the sky. On the left, a tall building is seen behind a stone archway. The alleyway ahead is bathed in light and shadow. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, capturing architectural and textural details effectively. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey. In the foreground, the cobblestone ground is scattered with barrels, baskets, and a sleeping dog. Figures are depicted engaging in various activities in the tranquil setting.

artworks.title: Pise: Corridore del Camposanto
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a room containing various sculptures and architectural elements. The sculptures, including human figures in robes, are made of light-colored stone. They are placed on plinths or incorporated into architectural structures. The room also has large chains on one wall and detailed frescoes or murals in muted tones. Natural light enters through high windows on the right.

artworks.title: Ponte de Nomentano (Bridge of Nomentano)
artworks.creditLine: Gift in honor of Ralph and Nancy Ellen Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a stone bridge with battlements over a river, viewed from a slightly lower side angle. The bridge and hills dominate the horizon, with a black-and-white, sepia-toned appearance. People are on the left riverbank, and a carriage and horses are on the far side. The landscape includes vegetation, creating a timeless atmosphere.

artworks.title: Temple of Vesta and Fountain, Rome
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a fountain surrounded by a circular basin and a historic structure in the background. The fountain is ornate with sculptural elements and aged surroundings. Geometry of the paving stones emphasizes the fountain. Behind it is the Temple of Hercules Victor, characterized by tall Corinthian columns and a conical roof. The temple is surrounded by trees and stone walls, creating a serene atmosphere. The image is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Piazza Colonna, Column of Marcus Aurelius and Chigi Palace
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a historic plaza with a tall, intricately carved column topped with a statue as the central focus. Classical architecture surrounds the plaza, featuring a row of windows and a pediment. In the foreground, there is a circular fountain with sculptural elements, reflecting light. Empty chairs and small structures are scattered around the fountain area. The color palette is monochrome sepia, giving the image a vintage appearance. The composition leads the viewer's eye from the fountain to the column and across the surrounding buildings in the plaza.

artworks.title: Ruined Tower
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man captured from the waist up, seated and leaning against a wooden railing. He is positioned outdoors, adjacent to the ruins of an ancient stone structure with one noticeable archway and a partially crumbled wall in the background. The man's facial features are soft, with a short haircut that blends into the rustic scene, and there is some blurring which does not clearly showcase his precise expression. He is wearing a suit with a buttoned jacket and is seated next to a small set of stairs leading to the elevated stone section. The area surrounding him is landscaped with overgrown foliage, indicative of an untamed garden or courtyard. The backdrop is minimal, primarily featuring the continuation of the old stone structures and a pale, featureless sky.

artworks.title: Théâtre Romain à Arles (Roman Theater in Arles)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a view of Roman ruins from a slightly elevated perspective. Stone remnants and ancient architecture populate the scene. The horizon is just below the midpoint, with a line of rustic buildings and a spired church tower in silhouette against the sky. Close by are scattered stone blocks and two columns, leading towards a semicircular stone structure. Steps on the right suggest an amphitheater. The image has a sepia tonality, highlighting the stone's texture and historical nature. The landscape appears sun-drenched and tranquil, emphasizing the weathered ruins against the village structures.

artworks.title: Rocher de St. Michel au Le Puy (Rock of St. Michel near Le Puy)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky formation with a chapel atop it. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a wide view of the landscape. The rocky mass dominates the scene, with the chapel as a focal point. The foreground has rough terrain with stone walls and sparse vegetation, leading to small buildings on the slopes. In the distance, there are hills with scattered trees and dwellings, merging into a soft, overcast sky. The image is in monochrome, emphasizing a classic and historical atmosphere. The color palette consists of natural earth tones, creating a harmonious look.

artworks.title: Cottage at Wilford
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows two boys reclining on the ground, partially hidden behind shrubbery and plants. A rustic thatched-roof cottage is seen beyond them, with a slightly disrepair roof and visible wooden boards. The cottage, made of stone or brick, has windows and an open doorway. A large tree is on the left, adding vertical interest. The horizon is unclear due to the foliage and cottage. Greenery surrounds the scene, contrasting with the cottage. The color scheme is sepia, emphasizing texture differences.

artworks.title: Thèbes, Colosses de Memnon (Thebes, Colossi of Memnon)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: Two colossal seated figures, known as the Colossi of Memnon, representing Pharaoh Amenhotep III. The statues are massive in size, with people standing and climbing on them, providing a sense of scale. The sculptures are made from stone and exhibit an aged, weathered surface with a light brown color. They are depicted in a traditional seated position with hands resting on the knees, facing forward. The landscape is flat and open, allowing the figures to stand prominently.

artworks.title: Amphitheatre at Taormina
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient ruin from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the image and merges with an uneven stone wall stretching across the scene. The photo is monochromatic with a sepia tone, dominated by rich browns and soft beiges, highlighting stone textures and sparse grass. Large stones and rubble are scattered around, with two individuals dressed in period attire interacting amongst the ruins. In the distance, rocky and overgrown terrain climbs towards dilapidated structures blending with the sky. The scene hints at historical intrigue and the passage of time.

artworks.title: Glen Kenilworth
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with a narrow, winding path leading into a dense forest. The canopy of trees obscures the horizon, with their branches interlocking above. The path disappears into the woods at eye level. The style is photographic, capturing the texture of tree bark and light patterns through the leaves. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray, highlighting light and shadow. Trees closest to the viewer are large, while the path leads into the distance.

artworks.title: On the Llugwy, at Miner's Bridge, Betws-y-Coed
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a river landscape with rocky terrain and trees lining the waterway. A person is sitting on a large rock near the river. The water flows over rocks, leading towards trees and hills in the distance. Misty hills obscure the horizon, giving depth to the scene. The color palette includes sepia and gray tones. Natural elements like rocks and foliage provide contrasting textures.

artworks.title: Pathway in Alexandra Park
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image displays a view of a winding path through a lush garden. The dense foliage and tall trees obstruct the horizon. The path curves gently, leading the eye through the scene. The bushes and trees provide a detailed texture against a cloudy sky. The color palette is primarily sepia and black, creating a nostalgic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Camp a Accaba
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a grove of palm trees. The horizon is low in the picture, just below the tops of the palm trees. A slightly hazy sky is visible behind the palm trees. The image has a soft-focus effect, blending elements gently. The color palette is sepia-toned. Two tent-like structures are visible on the left and right. More terrain is visible in the distance, emphasizing the vastness of the area.

artworks.title: Théâtre de Syracuse (Amphitheatre of Syracuse)
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient stone amphitheater. The perspective is slightly elevated. The horizon is unclear due to the rocky terrain. There is a small stone building with a tiled roof on the right side. The photo showcases the textures of the weathered stone and seating levels. The color palette is sepia. Vegetation grows between the stones.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in the center, flanked by two cows. The man wears a hat, white shirt, dark vest, and pants. He has a mustache and is looking down, shadowed by his hat. He holds a stick or lead in his right hand, connected to the cow on the left. On the right, a young boy holds the lead of the other cow. The boy wears a flat cap, jacket, and pants and stands behind the cow. The background is a blurred outdoor landscape with leafless trees, suggesting a rural setting. The ground is grassy, extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Floral and Berry Wreath
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro in honor of Sarah Greenough
artworks.description: The image shows a floral wreath made up of various large flowers and leaves, including dahlias, chrysanthemums, and clusters of small blossoms arranged in a circular formation. The color palette is monochromatic, possibly sepia-toned, creating a vintage aesthetic. The floral arrangement fills most of the frame, with the flowers arranged evenly in a circle, against a solid, untextured background.
